modifications: Narrowed triggers to explicit graph or cross-file evidence tasks and added freshness checks.
Removed fixed subagent lifecycle assumptions; worker dispatch now uses the actual host tool, bounded inline fallback, or an explicit missing-capability report.
Recorded failed, truncated, or invalid chunks as coverage gaps and made token usage unknown when the host does not expose it.
Pinned the local skill snapshot to v0.9.56 and added a Windows/PowerShell install boundary.
validation: Static content and host-boundary review only; no graphifyy install or end-to-end graph pipeline was run in this change.
